foundation-sec-8b.notes: Cisco Foundation AI domain-adapted base model (continued pretrain on Llama 3.1 8B). Use plain MCQ completion prompt.

llama-3.1-8b.notes: General-purpose base model; parent of Foundation-Sec-8B for base-vs-domain-adapted comparison.

lily-cyber-7b.notes: Mistral-7B instruct fine-tuned on cybersecurity QA.

zephyr-7b-beta.notes: Aligned Mistral-7B chat model; parent of ZySec-7B.

baronllm-v2.notes: GGUF-only (~16GB). Requires a running OpenAI-compatible server at --api-base-url. For Ollama, pull/create as baronllm-v2 (api_model_id) or pass --api-model.

qwen3-14b.notes: Instruction-tuned Qwen3 14B; parent of BaronLLM v2.0. OpenRouter: --api-base-url https://openrouter.ai/api with api_reasoning effort xhigh.

trendyol-cyber-70b.notes: GGUF-only (~42GB Q4_K_M). Pull: ollama pull hf.co/Trendyol/Trendyol-Cybersecurity-LLM-v2-70B-Q4_K_M then ollama cp ... trendyol-cyber-70b. Needs ~45GB VRAM per GPU instance.

llama-3.3-70b-instruct.notes: Meta instruct model; parent of Trendyol Cybersecurity LLM v2-70B. Local: HuggingFace. API: pass --api-base-url https://openrouter.ai/api and OPENROUTER_API_KEY.

cybertuned.notes: BERT-style encoder (not generative). Ranks MCQ options by masked-LM score; not comparable to generative LLM accuracy.

roberta-base.notes: General RoBERTa encoder; architectural parent of CyBERTuned for encoder baseline comparison.
